met_analysis:
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along long 55°E to the north of Lat 30°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast Rajasthan & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from northwest Uttar Pradesh to north Coastal Andhra Pradesh across Chhattisgarh and Odisha at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast Arabian Sea & adjoining Lakshadweep area at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Gulf of Mannar & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Assam & neighbourhood between 1.5 and 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
A Low Pressure Area is likely to form over Southeast Bay of Bengal around 13th November, 2026. It is likely to move northwestwards and become well marked low pressure area during subsequent 24 hours.
